from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityAgeRecord(BaseModel):
    """One university's reported average age of full-time undergraduate students."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    average_full_time_undergraduate_age: float | None = Field(description="Average age of full-time undergraduate students, as reported in Section F1")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period mentioned in the document")
    data_source_section: str | None = Field(description="The section where the data was found, e.g., 'Section F1'")
    undergraduate_category: str | None = Field(description="The specific category reported, e.g., 'Undergraduates', 'Full-time students'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_ages: list[UniversityAgeRecord]
